title: feat(console): a header action shows the reader already pressed it (`pressed` drawn as aria-pressed)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoJQJBhSpgsugbgL93YmdNzA)_

Fixes #28242
Refs #27946

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@object-ui/core` `ActionDef` gains the optional member `pressed`, typed by derivation from the spec's `ActionInput['pressed']`; no export, key or route is added)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录页头部按钮和「声明的动作栏」现在会读动作的 `pressed` 条件。条件成立时按钮显示为「已按下」（高亮底色，读屏念出「已按下」），不成立时是普通按钮。例如知识文章的「有帮助 / 没帮助」投票，读者已经投过哪一票，那个按钮就是按下状态。
- 为什么改：`pressed` 已在 #28235 写进 spec，但控制台一直不画，读者看不出自己是否已经投过票。
- 风险与回滚：只改显示层，按下的按钮照样可点、照样执行动作；条件算不出来时画成未按下并在控制台提示一次。没有声明 `pressed` 的动作完全不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`（`pressedFor` 与 `renderButton` 里的 `aria-pressed`）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx`（`useDeclaredActionPressed`）；`packages/qa/dogfood/test/expression-conformance.ledger.ts` 的 `cel-action-pressed` 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-pressed-28242.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.pressed-28242.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件、12 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`ActionDef` derives the key** (`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`): `pressed?: SpecActionInput['pressed']`, so it has the spec's arms (a CEL string or the `{ dialect, source }` envelope, no boolean). `actionKeys.ts` lists it in `ACTION_DEF_KEYS`, and the `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` comment no longer says it is inventory-only.

**The record header** (`page:header`, `PageHeaderActions` in `containers.tsx`). `pressedFor` evaluates a declared `pressed` through the header's one predicate entry, `evalHeaderPredicate` (the entry and bindings `visible` / `disabled` use), with `fallback: false`. An inline button whose action declares the predicate is a toggle button: `aria-pressed="true"` while it holds, `aria-pressed="false"` while it does not. An action that declares none carries no `aria-pressed`.

**The declared actions bar** (`DeclaredActionsBar.tsx`). `useDeclaredActionPressed` evaluates it with `useCondition` and `throwOnError`, on the same record binding as the bar's `visible` gate, and draws the same attribute.

**The pressed face** on both: Shadcn's toggle-on colours keyed off the attribute (`aria-pressed:bg-accent aria-pressed:text-accent-foreground hover:aria-pressed:bg-accent`, the spelling `PanelToggles` already uses), so the face and the attribute cannot disagree.

**Display only.** Nothing gates, greys or routes on the verdict: a pressed action stays enabled and still dispatches. A predicate that cannot be evaluated answers `false` (the unpressed button, never a claim that the reader acted) and is reported once. A boolean `pressed` is refused by the spec at parse, so neither surface gives it a reading.

**Re-stated in the same PR** (the card's cross-domain exception):

- `packages/spec/liveness/action.json` `pressed`: `planned` → `live`, citing the read points; `authorWarn` / `authorHint` dropped. The generated count shard `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/action.md` moves with it (`gen:liveness-counts`: live 48 → 49, planned 1 → 0).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/expression-conformance.ledger.ts` `cel-action-pressed`: `experimental` / `unevaluated` → `enforced` / `fail-soft-log`, naming both evaluators.
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`: the "not drawn yet" callout is gone; one bullet says which surfaces draw it and that a menu item does not.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-pressed-28242.test.tsx` (6) and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.pressed-28242.test.tsx` (6), the same six cases per surface: the vote that holds is `aria-pressed="true"` with the face and its sibling `"false"`; the envelope arm; a row without the served block draws both unpressed; a pressed action is enabled and dispatches; a faulting predicate draws `"false"` and warns; an action with no predicate has no `aria-pressed` and no face.

## Acceptance notes

- A menu item draws no pressed state: an action folded into the header's `⋯` overflow, and a lever in the declared actions bar's override menu. `aria-pressed` is not a menu item attribute; a checkable item (`menuitemcheckbox`) would be a different control. Recorded in the liveness note and the doc bullet.
- `aria-pressed="false"` (not an absent attribute) when a declared predicate is false: a declared `pressed` makes the button a toggle, which assistive technology announces as "not pressed". The look is the plain button, as the spec describes.
- The bar's fault warning comes from `useCondition`'s shared text, which says "was hidden/disabled"; the label it carries ends in `(pressed)`, and the button is drawn unpressed. The text is outside this card's surface.
- The four `action:*` renderers and `record:quick_actions` do not read `pressed`; the card names the header and the bar only.
